rapport_notes: Friendly and responsive but minimal personality; mostly transactional tone with frequent 'okay' acknowledgments.
process_discipline_notes: Rep asked 'any other questions I could answer for you while we're on the phone?' but did not hold silence—immediately pivoted to close without waiting for a genuine response.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'I'm just gonna grab the rest of the info from you and ask just a couple of questions' — no time-box or explicit promise of accurate quote in return.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'is there any like items or anything in particular you're like a concern about at the moment or before the move?' — but this comes after already discussing the move logistics (availability, stops, condo details).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises mirror concern ('floor link mirror that's taller than I am… been moved like six times'). Rep responds 'Alright… Yeah' but does not probe deeper; pivots immediately to logistics ('So, it's a two story condo').
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Rep says 'The movers will give you a call in the morning when they're on the way' and earlier discusses care with labeled items for storage, touching on attentiveness to special items.
evidence_quotes.communication: Rep explicitly states 'The movers will give you a call in the morning when they're on the way' — day-before contact covered.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_estimate_window: Rep says 'it's just that flat hourly rate… billed in fifteen minute increment, so you just pay for the time you… if we come under the estimate, you do only pay for that time.'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_self_prep: Rep says 'The main thing that adds the most time for us is miscellaneous items that don't get box like clothes and pictures, and things like that. So yeah, definitely better like prep you are the more efficient we can move.'
evidence_quotes.close: Rep says 'Well, I'm gonna send over this confirmation… and then outside of that, any other questions I could answer for you while we're on the phone?' — no rate-lock mentioned, no explicit ask like 'would you like our help with your move.'

top_strength: Rep successfully identified and acknowledged the customer's main concern (floor-length mirror) and maintained friendly, professional rapport throughout a multi-stop logistics discussion.
coaching_note: Lead with a time-boxed quid pro quo ('this should take about five minutes, and I'll get you an accurate quote'), ask the agenda question before diving into logistics details, and hold silence after open-ended questions like 'any other questions' instead of immediately closing.
